propositions: A crash after retired tombstone replacement but before live replacement leaves the same identity in both live and retired states, detectable but not safely repairable during construction-time or preview-time read-only operations.

Incomplete-operation recovery must be extracted from the facade and invoked once at the validated write-bearing reconcile boundary, immediately after under-lock staleness validation and before the first remote issue fetch.
Recovery completes retirement only when tombstone, forward entry, and reverse entry identities agree exactly; any mismatch or corrupt state safety-aborts without unrelated mutations.
Explicit unretire removes the tombstone intent and prevents completion; later automatic 200/clear_absent/same-key confirm does not implicitly resurrect a tombstoned identity.

Production code must use the narrow facade operation and never mutate binding entries obtained through all_bindings(); apply_handlers.py rich-text handler must be cut to S2 operation after RP-04 S3 lands.
The invocation site is reconcile.py after staleness validation, not run_differs.py, because no position in run_differs.py precedes the first remote observation.
